question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

115 95 77 61 47 ?
solution:
**Given Series:** 115 95 77 61 47 ?

The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f21a98021d5db3cd9faa72a54a153570bd23ba77f1c797f21e1fe1cb8a16af.png] 

The numbers are decreasing by consecutive even numbers:
